source.subject: test(browser): restore fact review and scoped visit receipts

baseline.observed_outcome: blocked_writes equality failed on four required visit POSTs
baseline.root_cause: The older fixture aborted every non-read request other than its existing synthetic rescore. Main's explicit job-card open now records a real profile-scoped visit as required by MJ-TH-015/#919.
baseline.latent_oracle_conflict: Allowing requests alone would also conflict with the old whole-database equality. The repair adds exact positive persisted visit checks and retains per-table equality for every other table.

repair.request_allowance: Only POST to the exact next local URL in that fixed list, with no body and fewer than four allowances consumed. Append before continuing to the real API; never synthesize a successful receipt.
completion_and_durability: Every explicit card click awaits its exact view POST response alongside the existing explanation response.
Require HTTP201 and the expected profile/job identity.
Require timezone-aware ISO timestamp text and equality with fresh persisted viewed_at.
Compare all persisted profile/job/visit_order tuples to the independently declared expected prefix after each visit.
After explanation retry, the complete visit-row dictionary equals its second-visit snapshot.
After rescore, the complete visit-row dictionary equals its third-visit snapshot.
The fourth visit belongs to other/network-one/order1 and preserves all first-profile rows byte-for-byte.
After browser close, exactly the four expected URLs have occurred, visit rows equal the verified final state, and every nonvisit table equals the existing post-refresh snapshot.
preserved_feature_oracles: Original profile/search/job identity and explanation score checks.
Transient503 retry and stale409 refresh behavior.
Contribution provenance, unknown AI signal and match-version checks.
Existing page/server/cleanup timeouts and test retry policy.
repair.old_snapshot_replacement: Only the obsolete final whole-database equality was replaced. Positive visit equality and per-table equality retain coverage for all persisted state; profile_job_views is not simply ignored.
limits: Timestamp assertions establish format and response/persistence agreement, not an independent wall-clock freshness bound.
This repair does not newly certify all pre-existing fixture interceptors.
No changes to the two peer-owned role-scoring fixtures.

reviewed_behavior.fixed_oracle: Four expected profile/job/order tuples are declared before requests and never changed; URLs derive only from these fixture constants and the local origin.
reviewed_behavior.request_guard: POST only, exact full local URL in fixed next-position order, no body, length below four; append before continuation consumes each allowance exactly once.
reviewed_behavior.wrong_request_rejection: Wrong profile, wrong job, repeated prior URL, unexpected URL/query, body, method, or fifth POST cannot satisfy the view allowance. Non-read methods then enter the existing abort-and-record path; final blocked_writes must stay empty.
reviewed_behavior.completion_fence: Each of the four explicit job clicks is enclosed by an exact-URL POST response waiter; helper requires HTTP 201 and checks persisted rows only afterward.
reviewed_behavior.positive_persistence: Every helper compares all persisted profile/job/visit_order tuples against the independent expected prefix. Returned profile/job must match the fixed tuple; timestamp must be timezone-aware ISO text and equal persisted viewed_at.
reviewed_behavior.retry_no_visit: The explanation retry must leave the whole visit-row dictionary equal to the snapshot taken after the second expected 201.
reviewed_behavior.refresh_no_visit: The refresh retains the exact visit dictionary captured after the third expected 201 while preserving the existing single allowed match change and all other table comparisons.
reviewed_behavior.profile_isolation: The fourth receipt is other/network-one/order1; first-profile complete view rows must remain identical to the third-visit snapshot.
reviewed_behavior.final_oracle: Exactly four expected URLs must have been observed, all original external/AI/submission/blocked-write lists remain empty, and after browser close every non-visit table equals database_after_refresh while the view table equals the independently checked fourth receipt state.
reviewed_behavior.preserved_scope: Original explanation scores, profile/search identity, transient 503 retry, stale 409 refresh, contribution provenance, unknown AI signal, rescore count and match-version assertions remain unchanged.

scope_limits: Timestamp assertions establish timezone-aware format and response/persistence agreement; they do not independently bound wall-clock freshness. No broader recently-viewed acceptance is claimed.
This review covers the new visit-specific allowance and retained regression assertions, not a new certification of all pre-existing fixture interceptors.
The parent owns the live path claim and eventual exact-commit hosted validation; this reviewer did not acquire or alter coordination state.
No production code, workflow or canonical acceptance edit was made by this reviewer.
